pages.title: A captured essence
pages.text: “Living beings are made to touch the world. Even when their feet no longer touch the ground, their hands must not lose their strength.”$(br2)The Gloves of the Living restore to ghosts the ability to interact with the material world while in flight.

pages.title: The Power of the Living
pages.text: The gloves allow you to mine blocks at normal speed, even while flying. Simply hold the gloves in your main hand or off-hand, or place them in a Vault cell.
